build_boundary: JE-2000C US is not a phase2 target. build_content.py binds the transcription to shared ComponentSpecs; rebuild.py replays them through manual-ir/v2 and the shared Web/MyST pipeline with the prepared-document shared-style gate. The manual prints no symbol-meaning table, so there is no symbol admission.
